items.headline: Albemarle gains as Mizuho upgrades stock on surging energy storage demand
items.snippet: Albemarle shares advanced 4% in premarket following an upgrade from Mizuho Securities, which cited accelerating demand for stationary storage as a catalyst for tighter lithium market balances. Price target $130.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong Battery Energy Storage (BESS) demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory; Albemarle is the lowest-cost lithium producer.

items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Albemarle, the world's largest lithium producer, has suffered as lithium prices have tanked ~80% from late 2022 highs. Earnings revisions fell after disappointing guidance; Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell).

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered its price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating. Supply and demand trends in the lithium market appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO Capital lowered its price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating, citing recent spot price weakness; still views the group as oversold.
